purpose: A simple calculator with a minimalist UI, bright colors, and geometric background shapes.
PROJECT_SCOPE: A client-side calculator app that performs basic arithmetic (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) using HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JS.

APPROVED_FEATURES.name: Arithmetic Operations
APPROVED_FEATURES.expected_behavior: Display numbers and calculate results based on standard order of operations logic handled by JS eval/logic.
APPROVED_FEATURES.validation: Prevent division by zero, prevent invalid operator sequences.
APPROVED_FEATURES.error_handling: Display 'Error' on division by zero or malformed input.
APPROVED_FEATURES.data_flow: Input -> Event Listener -> Calculation Logic -> Display Update

APPROVED_FEATURES.name: Minimalist UI with Bright Colors
APPROVED_FEATURES.expected_behavior: Bright color palette applied via CSS.

APPROVED_FEATURES.name: Geometric Background
APPROVED_FEATURES.expected_behavior: Static background with simple CSS shapes.

pages.name: index.html
pages.UI behavior: Buttons respond to click, result appears in display
pages.loading/error/success states: Error shown on division by zero

files.purpose: Layout, bright colors, and geometric shapes

FRONTEND_AGENT_PROMPT: Implement a calculator app using only index.html, style.css, and script.js. The calculator must perform basic arithmetic (+, -, *, /) and include a clear button. Feature IDs: FEATURE_001, FEATURE_002, FEATURE_003. Use a minimalist UI with bright colors and CSS-based geometric shapes in the background. Use vanilla JS for logic. Handle division by zero. SCOPE ENFORCEMENT: The Orchestrator specification is authoritative. Implement exactly and only the listed functionality. Do not invent, infer, add convenience/standard/future features, unrequested CRUD, extra fields, pages, navigation, UI, validation, or data operations. Every element, function, event handler, operation, field, page, and file must trace to an approved feature ID. Use only HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript, JSON seed data when specified, and localStorage when specified. Never implement a backend, API call, SQL/database, framework, or server-side code. Never pretend JavaScript can write data.json. If a dependency appears necessary but is unspecified, do not implement it: report UNAUTHORIZED_DEPENDENCY with what is needed, why, which approved feature requires it, and affected files. Implement the minimum complete system.
